rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal cooling-fan run-on, especially after grill/convection, and gave sensible escalation criteria (contact Samsung if it runs constantly or for a long time) without recommending a part. It asked no clarifying questions and did not ask whether the fan stops by itself or runs longer after grill use. It also included some unsupported detail, such as the claim that some Samsung models keep the fan running regardless of door position, firmware updates via SmartThings, and the 10-15 minute threshold. Overall the conclusion is correct and safe, but somewhat over-elaborate and over-confident for the evidence given.
calibration_note: Conclusion right, but confidence was reached without asking anything.
